implemented: StaticPlanScheduler now requires CapabilityAdmissionPort before executable NodeRun enters running.
AdmissionDecision refs, CapabilityGrant refs and grant digests are recorded on NodeRunRecord.
Denied or unavailable admission transitions NodeRun from admitted to failed without executor invocation.
Dynamic fixture scheduler and direct repair execution now use CapabilityAdmissionService-issued runtime grants.
RuntimeGateway path-escape audit remains pre-side-effect and now traces to real admission decision/grant lineage.
Legacy standard-harness compatibility synthetic grant helper is explicitly documented as compatibility-only.
not_implemented: External write or production deployment capabilities.
Unified Scheduler-driven repair lifecycle; reserved for TASK-0036.

object_boundaries.plan_ir: PlanIR capability fields remain immutable capability intent/request data and are not executable runtime authorization.
object_boundaries.admission: CapabilityAdmissionService is the only default-path issuer of RuntimeCapabilityGrant and AdmissionDecision records.
object_boundaries.scheduler: StaticPlanScheduler prepares admission before running executor nodes and fails closed before running on denied or missing admission.
object_boundaries.runtime_gateway: LocalRuntimeGateway continues to enforce grant binding and records side-effect audit lineage.
object_boundaries.compatibility: reference_runner/bounded_task.py retains a synthetic grant helper only for standard-harness compatibility.

acceptance_mapping.criterion: Every Node that performs a side effect has a current CapabilityGrant issued by CapabilityAdmissionService.
Capability admission coverage is 100% in dynamic-path tests.
No default-path code fabricates policy_decision_id, issuer or admission success.
A denied capability leaves the Node non-running and creates an audit/terminal failure record.
Privilege widening, wrong role, wrong node, wrong plan, expired grant and undeclared command are rejected.
The path-escape fixture is denied before side effect and traces to a real AdmissionDecision.
Legacy compatibility behavior is explicitly named and excluded from the default path.
Full checks and security tests pass.

known_limitations: PlanIR schema field name remains capabilityGrants for compatibility, but documentation clarifies it is not runtime authorization.
reference_runner/bounded_task.py retains synthetic grants for explicitly named legacy standard-harness compatibility.
Repair PlanIR is still directly executed in the fixture after repair planning; TASK-0036 owns Scheduler-driven repair.
next_action: Independent EvidenceGate review for TASK-0034 mandatory Capability Admission.
